document.abstract: Tests have been made with a recorder built to produce variable-area 8mm negatives suitable for high-speed duplication, using the 8mm standard picture format and the suggested 0.050 by 0.050-in. perforation, with the sound located between the outer edge of the perforations and the edge of the film.
